notes.title: Update Version 1.0
notes.notes: [p]Hello everyone,[/p][p]This is the last major update for Survival Hold Your Self.[/p][p]Please read the patch notes. If you have any questions or find any further bugs, please use the Discord server. Thank you.[/p][p]Bug Fixes:[/p][p]1. Compass display is no longer visible when a different UI is open.[/p][p]2. Game performance improved.[/p][p]3. Sound bugs at the waterfront fixed.[/p][p]4. Bandits sometimes didn't attack the player. Fixed.[/p][p]New Features:[/p][p]You can now purchase an NPC companion from the merchant. This companion can craft items at a crafting table you can build without requiring a request, but it takes a little longer.[/p][p]Thank you for your feedback.[/p]

notes.title: Release date
notes.notes: [p]Hello everyone,[/p][p]Today I want to share with you the exact release date of the EA for Survival Hold Your Self. But first, I'd like to thank the 50 people who have added Survival Hold Your Self to their wishlist. You might also be wondering how much the game will cost.[/p][p]Since it's my first game, I've decided to set a price of $9.99.[/p][p]Now we come to the release date of Survival Hold Your Self. You don't have to wait too long.[/p][p]It's already happening on July 1st.[/p][p]For everyone who decides to buy it, I'd like to thank you in advance and wish you lots of fun with Survival Hold Your Self.[/p][p]I'll publish a roadmap for the release.[/p]

notes.title: Gameplay Trailer and Release Date EA
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, 

I've been working hard on the gameplay trailer over the past few days so you can see it as early as possible. Check out the latest gameplay trailer for Survival Hold Your Self here.


[previewyoutube=2w7IcC1uQyU;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

Now we come to the news that you're probably most interested in: the EA release.

Unfortunately, I can't give you a 100 percent exact date at the moment. But if everything goes according to plan and there are no further major problems, I'm planning an EA release in late August / early September.

I'll announce the exact date here a few days in advance. Should any unexpected problems arise and the EA release be delayed, I'll let you know in a timely manner.

If you have any further questions or suggestions, feel free to stop by my Discord server. Thanks, see you soon.
